title: Liquidity, Tariffs, Memes, and Tax-Loss Harvesting Aftermath
summary: Trade architecture, liquidity and rotation risks.
coverage_note: All macro, tariff scenarios, digital assets, tax-loss examples and gold sections reviewed. Illustrative tariff arithmetic is separated from actual policy predictions; disputed wallet ownership is not treated as an established allegation.

framework_lessons: Separate funding channels from net trade balances.
assessment: The dated Brazil rebound and bitcoin breakout worked, while equal-weight rotation and the shorter debt-ceiling dispute did not. Brazil current-account and TRUMP allocation errors are clear. The trade framework correctly highlights adjustment costs but overstates the necessity of US deficits for dollar creation. These errors should remain visible even where investment direction succeeded.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
